title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 432 (Right to legal representation)

content.overview: A party to a proceeding before the Tribunal or the Appellate Tribunal may appear in person or authorise a legal practitioner or a chartered accountant, cost accountant or company secretary to present the case.
content.glance: A party to a proceeding before the Tribunal or the Appellate Tribunal may appear in person or authorise a legal practitioner or a chartered accountant, cost accountant or company secretary to present the case.
content.study: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 432 (Right to legal representation). A party to a proceeding before the Tribunal or the Appellate Tribunal may appear in person or authorise a legal practitioner or a chartered accountant, cost accountant or company secretary to present the case. Apply only the conditions, approvals, filings and penalties stated in the section. A rule made under the Act cannot contradict the section. Not a verified closure.
